# Chronograph LP

Skills and agents that teach agents to work with Chronograph LP. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [chronograph-pe/chronograph-lp-claude-plugin](https://github.com/chronograph-pe/chronograph-lp-claude-plugin), at commit `322b2d3`.

Portfolio monitoring and analytics for private capital LP teams.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Chronograph LP**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Chronograph LP**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install chronograph-lp@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

4 skills: `chronograph-cashflow-forecast`, `chronograph-commitment-pacing-planner`, `chronograph-gp-meeting-prep`, `chronograph-look-through-exposure-scan`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.
